conclaves.title: The Ledger
conclaves.description: For a decision you can't take back. Two agents build opposing lists (sunk cost vs opportunity cost); a code node finds overlap via semantic similarity. No LLM interprets the result — you read the highlighted ledger and decide.

conclaves.title: Code Review
conclaves.description: Depth review of a single file: Context + Usage + KB sweep → 5 parallel specialists (correctness, security, tests, conventions, design) → Best Practices → Lead Reviewer with channel loop → markdown saved to .reviews/.
